verdict_ko: 관측 선언·누적 쓰기 위치와 R3 목적지 XINT 사본은 원본 native 연산을 보존한다. 선택 clear→CN coupling 최초 음수→carry→continuum→PANEL_PRE 경계는 작은 실제 result에 명확히 한정되어 있다. 전체 operand 생성 계보와 LBL reference는 false/FAIL이다. 원시 trace/OD/log을 재검증하지 않았다. 저장 verifier의 roster 및 비교 receipt 모순 방지 두 보강점은 root에 전달했으며 현재 실행의 오류로 단정하지 않는다.

source_only_scope.source_gzip_read: Only source/oprop.stock.f90.gz and source/oprop.observer.f90.gz decompressed as Fortran source.

source_checks.restoration: Removing all UDM37_MIN marker blocks and reverting exactly3 observer XINT calls restores stock bytes plus the explicitly disclosed separator newline.
source_checks.XINT_copy: Independent string comparison after removing read-only helper lines and renaming the private routine recovers exact native XINT body. Public XINT signature/body and other5 call sites unchanged.
source_checks.declarations: USE statements precede existing USE/IMPLICIT; REAL*8 temporary is a declaration before COMMON/executable code. Added module state explicitly initialized/default-off; IR4=0 at stock206 before min_init; observation helper reads only native operands already used by selected statements.
source_checks.CN_writes: Baseline R3+=STRF3*F3 and coupling R3+=STRF3*F3*ZF3L statements unchanged. Temporary before read guarded on active/valid selected index, immediately followed by same guarded postwrite capture; original terms/mixing physics not redefined.
source_checks.R3_XINT_roster: Exactly three existing final R3 destination calls replaced: HIRAC1 R4, HIRAC1 ABSRB continuum, XSECTM RX. R1/R2/R4 and internal RX interpolation still public XINT.
source_checks.alias_scope: Stock XSECTM4562/4609 aliases R3(1) with RR3(1); RX is separately declared in /XSECTP/ at4592. Internal RX writes are not direct R3 accumulator writes. R4 separate /LBLF/ at4579. R4 activation and RSYM require held-case absence rather than broad inactive guarantee.
source_checks.PANEL_scope: Stock PANEL writes R3 by forward carry J=151..283 to destinations1..133, then tail clear134..283. Carry source J is never a destination in this loop and remains unmodified when logger reads it after destination assignment. CLEAR records a zero definition, not the actual old pre-clear value.
source_checks.ownership: Target selected by native VFT+(index-1)*DVR3 within declared1e-7 matching rule. Index path170→20, layer21, actual MAX3=283; runtime panel IDs are context and not assumed equal to historical owner IDs.
source_checks.limitations: No generic thread-safe/per-process concurrent logger guarantee; held solver single process. No all-layer, active R4, other target, input coefficient-generation or continuum stencil-origin closure.

remaining_limits: This independent review did not replay native trace, decode OD, run saved verifier, or execute its four trace-mutation tests.
Selected accumulator arithmetic observed/replayed does not independently validate STRF3/F3/ZF3L input-generation ancestry or absolute AER record/molecule/isotope identity.
Signed coupling first negative is not proof of erroneous physics, missing necessary positive cancellation, or permission to clip/remove it.
Full-file timestamp failures remain preserved separately from record-byte equality.
All physical acceptance and original19/current12/15scoped+7physical gates remain unpromoted.
